answer: To qualify for jury rewards, each identity must answer a fresh private calibration set, including sable habitat, crystal defects and solar zenith calculations. Reveal instances only after enrollment and independently verify known answers. Require a new set each round, so buying one solved set cannot qualify a thousand keys. A farm pays inference and checking costs per active seat; set rewards below that cost for unskilled guessing. Leaked test banks or cheap specialized solvers weaken this defense.
